title: 第三章 破樊笼
novel_title: 穿书被杀妻证道？魔尊追妻夜夜哄
content_zh:
谢之涵执起手中绣着桃枝的团扇，不紧不慢地轻摇着，唇角噙着一丝若有似无的笑：“哼，她这婚事若成了，谢家便与薛家结了姻亲，且不说能借着薛家的势往上走几步，单是对方指缝里漏下点资源，就够我们修行路上轻松不少。”

    她说着将团扇往妹妹那边遮了遮，压低嗓音，眼中闪过精光：“到那时，你我还愁找不到更好的道侣？自然是，能择良木而栖，何必一直困在这日渐没落的家里。”

    话音微顿，想起谢清猗之前在阁内那副油盐不进的样子，她胸中恼意翻涌，手中团扇不由摇得急了些，带起细微的凉风：“她在天极仙府这些年，除了空有个名头让外人忌惮谢家三分，我们何时曾真正沾到半点实惠？”

    谢之妙眸光微动，面上却仍是一派温婉，轻声道：“姐姐思虑周全，只是三姐姐先前态度坚决，此事怕是……”

    “婚姻大事，岂容她一个女儿家自作主张？”谢之涵冷哼一声，打断妹妹的话，眼底掠过一丝不屑，“上有家主，下有宗族长老，哪个世家子弟真敢悖逆家族？就算她背靠天极仙府，难道还敢公然叛出家族不成？”

    她拉起妹妹的手，手指微微用力：“世家子弟若没了这层身份，便与那些无根无萍的散修一般无二，往后她还妄想嫁入什么高门？”

    在她看来，修仙世家的联姻，核心在于那张盘根错节的姻亲网络，这直接关系到对灵脉，秘境，丹药等修行资源的掌控与分配。

    即便谢清猗是剑仙亲传又如何，天极仙府这些年来，可未曾因此提携谢家分毫，足见她并不受师门重视。

    “一个既不被师门看重，又不为家族所容的人。”谢之涵眼波一转，握着的团扇的手此刻停了下来，“也不知还在傲气些什么，待大伯父亲自过问，有她好看的！”

    晚风拂过庭院，灵雾在假山石间缓缓流淌，廊下灯笼的光晕微微晃动，将两姐妹的影子拉得细长，远处隐约传来几声啼鸣，更衬得此处的角落私语低回，算计深藏。

    谢清猗刚穿过游廊，便被先前引路的侍女再次拦住了去路。

    “三小姐，”侍女毕恭毕敬地行礼，语气却不容置疑，“家主夫人请您务必再过去一趟。”

    “我的态度已很明确了，”谢清猗脚步未停，声音冷淡，“再说多少次，答案也一样，让她死了这条心吧。”她侧身欲绕开对方。

    “夫人说……”侍女见状急忙提高声量，语速加快，生怕她瞬息间便消失，“若三小姐执意不去，那关于您父母前往上古迷域前的旧事，便也无需知晓了，那枚‘影留珠’，自然也不会交给您。”

    谢清猗闻言，脸上那点仅存的笑意彻底敛去，眼底凝起寒霜，声音微沉：“我平生最恨受人威胁，我想知道的事，自有办法查明，不劳家主夫人费心。”

    话音未落，她已凭身体本能，足尖在铺着卵石地面上轻轻一点，灵力自然流转，身形便如掠水的飞燕轻盈跃起，裙摆拂过廊下的台阶，瞬息便消失在侍女惊愕的视线里。

    待到稳稳落在一处僻静院落的月洞门外，她才后知后觉地抚了抚胸口，一阵心悸，刚才真是逞强了！

    念头刚过，她大脑却猛地宕机了一下，等等，这句感叹不对劲！她怎么不自觉就代入原身那文绉绉的古人腔调了？

    重来一次！她赶紧在脑内切换回自己的OS系统，由衷感慨，天啦噜！我居然真的飞啦～
content_en:
Xie Zhihan held up the round fan embroidered with peach branches in his hand and shook it slowly, with a faint smile on his lips: "Humph, if her marriage is successful, the Xie family will be married to the Xue family, not to mention taking advantage of the Xue family to take a few steps forward, just by leaking some resources from the other party's fingers, it will be a lot easier for us to practice."

    As she spoke, she covered her sister with her ball fan, lowered her voice, and a light flashed in her eyes: "At that time, you and I will still be worried about not being able to find a better Taoist companion? Of course, if you can choose a good tree to live in, why stay trapped in this declining home."

    She paused for a moment, remembering Xie Qingyi's desolate look in the pavilion before. Annoyance surged in her chest, and she couldn't help shaking the fan in her hand more quickly, bringing up a slight cool breeze: "In the past few years in Tianji Immortal Mansion, except for the fact that she has a name that makes others fear the Xie family, when have we ever really benefited from it?"

    Xie Zhimiao's eyes moved slightly, but her face was still gentle, and she said softly: "Sister, I've thought carefully about it, but the third sister was resolute before, so I'm afraid this matter..."

    "How can we allow her, a daughter, to make her own decisions regarding matters of marriage?" Xie Zhihan snorted coldly, interrupting his sister, with a trace of disdain in his eyes, "With the head of the family above, and the clan elders below, which family member would really dare to rebel against the family? Even if she has Tianji Immortal Mansion behind her, how dare she betray the family openly?"

    She took her sister's hand and put a little force on her fingers: "If the children of the aristocratic family lose this identity, they will be no different from those casual cultivators without roots. What high-profile family will she hope to marry in the future?"

    In her opinion, the core of the marriage between the immortal cultivating families lies in the intricate network of in-laws, which is directly related to the control and distribution of spiritual veins, secret realms, elixirs and other cultivation resources.

    Even if Xie Qingyi is a direct descendant of the Sword Immortal, Tianji Immortal Mansion has not helped the Xie family in the slightest over the years, which shows that she is not valued by the master.

    "A person who is neither valued by the master nor tolerated by the family." Xie Zhihan's eyes turned, and the hand holding the fan stopped at this moment, "I don't know what he is still arrogant about. When uncle and father ask themselves, she is more attractive!"

    The evening breeze blew through the courtyard, and the spiritual mist flowed slowly among the rockery rocks. The halo of the lanterns in the corridor swayed slightly, making the shadows of the two sisters elongated. A few cries could be faintly heard in the distance, which made the whispers in the corners here, and the calculations hidden deep.

    As soon as Xie Qingyi passed through the verandah, he was blocked again by the maid who had led the way before.

    "Third Miss," the maid saluted respectfully, but her tone was unquestionable, "Mrs. Madam, please be sure to come over again."

    "My attitude is very clear," Xie Qingyi said in a cold voice without stopping, "No matter how many times I say it, the answer will be the same, let her give up." She turned sideways to avoid the other party.

    "Madam said..." Seeing this, the maid hurriedly raised her voice and spoke faster, for fear that she would disappear in an instant, "If the third lady insists on not going, then there is no need to know about the past events of your parents before they left for the Ancient Mysterious Realm, and the 'Shadow Bead' will naturally not be given to you."

    When Xie Qingyi heard this, the remaining smile on his face completely disappeared, his eyes were filled with frost, and his voice was low: "I hate being threatened the most in my life. There are ways to find out what I want to know, without the trouble of the master and his wife."

    Before she finished speaking, she relied on her body's instinct and tapped her toes lightly on the pebbled ground. Her spiritual energy flowed naturally, and she jumped up like a flying swallow skimming the water. Her skirt brushed the steps of the corridor, and she disappeared from the maid's astonished sight in an instant.

    When she landed safely outside the moon cave door of a secluded courtyard, she caressed her chest belatedly, her heart palpitating, she was so brave just now!

    Just after the thought passed, her brain suddenly shut down. Wait, there is something wrong with this exclamation! Why did she unconsciously assume the original person's refined ancient accent?

    Do it again! She quickly switched back to her own OS system in her mind and sighed sincerely, Oh my God! I actually really flew~
